notes.title: July 16, 2025 - Update
notes.content: [p]- Added change log[/p][p]- Added feedback/bug report form button![/p][p]- Added analytics[/p][p]- Explosive bullets should no longer trigger multiple explosions unless bounce is equipped (most notably prevents poison from stacking multiple times from a single bullet)[/p][p]- Charge + Gatling should now be more exciting, albeit a bit chaotic[/p][p]- Charge + Cannon should no longer take literally forever[/p][p]- Cannon + Bounce should no longer result in bullets being limply pooped out of the gun (sorry!)[/p][p]- Charge shot should now have some visual feedback on the cross hair when charge is complete[/p][p]- Poison and Rupture should now both be affected by the Peashooter Overtime Bonus[/p][p]- Escape button should now back out of most menu screens[/p][p]- Reduced chromatic aberration on the ship interior's screen; if it's still too much, LET US KNOW![/p][p]- Minor secondary fire rate fix[/p][p]- Glass effect from credits is now also used in the Options menu on the Main Menu screen[/p][p]- Removed screen shake from charge shot (updating to gun shake in the future)[/p][p]- Fixed various dialogue issues[/p][p]- Minor map tweaks[/p][p]- Rupture and Poison reworks![/p][p]- Rupture and Poison should now act appropriately when landing enhanced bullets[/p][p]- Nerfed base gun damage upgrade[/p][p]- Reload speed issue fixed[/p][p]- Nerfed reload speed slightly[/p][p]- Various mod balance changes[/p][p]- Tutorial text reworded (not currently translated)[/p][p]- Minor mission re-balancing[/p][p]- Infinite mission health scaling reduced a bit[/p][p]- HUD should no longer struggle to display on screens with weird aspect ratios[/p][p]- Aspect ratios locked to multiples of 16:9 and 16:10 for now, as a workaround for the above[/p][p]- Mouse input should no longer become jittery after dying and respawning[/p][p]- Freeze turret should actually work again[/p][p]- Explody-plants should flash slightly more obviously[/p][p]- When Crawlers phase into the ground on the Tutorial mission due to lag, they should now rest in peace instead of rotting in purgatory[/p][p]- Dialogue box made more prominent[/p][p]- Shop and Load out tutorial boxes made more eye-catching (color change)[/p]

tags.bug: - Explosive bullets should no longer trigger multiple explosions unless bounce is equipped (most notably prevents poison from stacking multiple times from a single bullet)
- Charge + Gatling should now be more exciting, albeit a bit chaotic
- Charge + Cannon should no longer take literally forever
- Cannon + Bounce should no longer result in bullets being limply pooped out of the gun (sorry!)

tags.feature: - Charge shot should now have some visual feedback on the cross hair when charge is complete

tags.bug: - Poison and Rupture should now both be affected by the Peashooter Overtime Bonus

tags.feature: - Escape button should now back out of most menu screens

tags.balance_change: - Reduced chromatic aberration on the ship interior's screen; if it's still too much, LET US KNOW!

tags.feature: - Glass effect from credits is now also used in the Options menu on the Main Menu screen

tags.bug: - Removed screen shake from charge shot (updating to gun shake in the future)
- Rupture and Poison should now act appropriately when landing enhanced bullets

tags.balance_change: - Infinite mission health scaling reduced a bit

tags.bug: - HUD should no longer struggle to display on screens with weird aspect ratios

tags.feature: - Aspect ratios locked to multiples of 16:9 and 16:10 for now, as a workaround for the above

tags.bug: - Mouse input should no longer become jittery after dying and respawning
- Freeze turret should actually work again
- Explody-plants should flash slightly more obviously
- When Crawlers phase into the ground on the Tutorial mission due to lag, they should now rest in peace instead of rotting in purgatory

tags.feature: - Shop and Load out tutorial boxes made more eye-catching (color change)
